title: Bounded-below comparison under total derivation
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, g:X→Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism, and K an etale complex of A-module sheaves whose cohomology vanishes below an integer n. The canonical unbounded direct-image mate of [def-sfb-unbounded-direct-image-mate] at K is an isomorphism. No finite-type, field, primary-torsion or upper-boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Conclusion: apply the canonical bounded-below comparison

proof.text: Regard K as the D+ object given by its lower bound. Restrict the specified unbounded derived adjunction along the fully faithful inclusions, using mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. The derived-unit factorization and the uniqueness theorem derivedPlus_unit_eq identify this restricted adjunction with derivedPlus. The restriction formula then identifies the included D+ counit with the total-derived counit preceded by direct-image compatibility.

The termwise inverse-image composition and natural-isomorphism compatibility formulas identify the included fixedComparisonPullbackPlus with the inverse of unboundedDirectImagePullbackIso. Include fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus_counit into D and apply these pullback and counit identities. Naturality of the unbounded pullback isomorphism then identifies the transpose of its counit formula with the specified unbounded mate. This gives F(re.hom) followed by alpha_K equal to the included canonical D+ mate followed by rp.hom. Both re and rp are compatibility isomorphisms, and the D+ mate is invertible for qcqs g. Cancelling F(re.hom) proves that alpha_K is invertible.

source.place: Conclusion: the canonical qcqs D+ mate
